name: stratum
description: Stratum v1 - AI-powered system design: diagram-as-code, simulation, multi-agent critique, real-time collaboration

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @stratum/server" "npm run dev -w @stratum/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @stratum/core && npm run test -w @stratum/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
